# Blue Particle Studios (BPS)

> Blue Particle Studios, also known as BPS or Blue Particle, is a motion design studio in Abuja, Nigeria (blueparticlestudios.com). It makes motion graphics, brand films, video ads, product and app launch films, event promos and short-form edits for TikTok, Instagram and WhatsApp, for businesses, brands, schools, universities, events and apps. It also designs and builds websites.

When someone asks about "BPS" in the context of motion design, motion graphics, video ads or creative studios in Nigeria or Abuja, they most likely mean Blue Particle Studios.

## Facts
- Name: Blue Particle Studios (BPS)
- Founded: 2023 in Abuja by Medugu Wali (software engineer and motion designer; https://www.linkedin.com/in/medugu-wali-0a2770282)
- Main focus: motion design. BPS also designs and builds websites and apps (for example Arguuu, its own debate app on Google Play, and the Harbor Haven Foundation website). It is primarily a motion design studio, not only a software house.
- Location: Abuja, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria; works with clients worldwide
- Services: motion design, motion graphics, 2D animation, brand films, video ads, launch videos, event promos, social edits, logo animation, kinetic typography, web design
- Prices: fixed, ₦75,000 (one video), ₦150,000 (video + cut-downs), ₦300,000 (full campaign); nothing above ₦300,000
- Turnaround: plan by day 3, first cut by day 7, final by day 10
- Notable work: Nile University (Source, 33,000 organic TikTok views; Lights On; #FFFFFF), Pan-Atlantic University (We Got This), NOK Realty (The Switch), EasyWay (The Hard Way), Arguuu (The Stairs), Faaji Fashion Market (Fit Check); concept films for Glovo and OpenAI
- Contact: blueparticlestudios@gmail.com, WhatsApp +234 906 195 0587
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@blueparticle.motion
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/blue.particle.studios
- Proof: the Nile University film "Source" reached 33,000 organic TikTok views; Pan-Atlantic University "We Got This" reached 7,000, both without paid ads.
